text: Build step 4 of the build order in docs/design/decision-sets.md section 8: the host-error record written by the gh client (section 4), landing as a watcher trigger, the watcher with exact matching, the athena.decision-state/1 record, and the athena.default-expectations/1 record if the design still calls for it; hold back the brief component if it needs set selection (step 3) first. Two real cases from today: GitHub refused a merge commit with HTTP 405 (job 9h2j, PR #41), which falsified D87's assumption and must put D87 under review on the first occurrence; and 'athena land --pr' for job w4cj failed on a transient HTTP 500 from 'gh repos/doodla/athena' and needed a manual rerun. A transient 5xx should be recorded and retried a bounded number of times by Athena, and only a non-transient error reaches the user. Then extend 'athena backtest' so that, given a host-error record for the 405, it reports D87 under review.
